purpose: Choose one primary path for project startup instead of presenting a catalog of possible tools.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs a real repository workflow: inspect, modify, commit, review, or open a PR.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only provides a snippet or asks for coding advice.
rules.fallback_to_native: Analyze pasted code or prepare a change plan without repository access.

rules.why_this_plugin: The real design file is the source of layout, components, spacing, styles, and assets.
rules.when_to_skip: No real Figma file or design system is involved.
rules.fallback_to_native: Create a UI plan or implementation from written requirements.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs to read, organize, edit, or export real cloud files.
rules.when_to_skip: The content is pasted into chat or stored locally.
rules.fallback_to_native: Work with provided text or create a local draft.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs access to real mail to read, summarize, draft, reply, or send.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only wants writing help for pasted email text.
rules.fallback_to_native: Polish or draft text without mailbox access.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs to inspect, create, or change real calendar events.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only needs a written schedule or agenda.
rules.fallback_to_native: Create a proposed plan without editing a calendar.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs reliable handling of real PDF files and format-preserving output.
rules.when_to_skip: The source is plain text or the user only needs a document outline.
rules.fallback_to_native: Plan the workflow or generate the content without processing files.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs a real workbook or structured dataset to read, clean, calculate, or visualize.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only provides a small pasted table.

rules.why_this_plugin: The core deliverable is an editable structured presentation.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only needs an outline or speaker notes.
rules.fallback_to_native: Create an outline and content plan.

rules.why_this_plugin: The core output requires generating, editing, or batch-processing visual assets.
rules.when_to_skip: The user only wants a prompt, concept, or text description.
rules.fallback_to_native: Write the prompt or art direction.

rules.why_this_plugin: The result depends on current public information that must be verified.
rules.when_to_skip: The user wants a timeless explanation or works from supplied sources.
rules.fallback_to_native: Explain the concept or analyze the supplied material.

rules.why_this_plugin: The task needs an external private system or custom capability outside native Codex.
rules.when_to_skip: No named external system or custom action is required.
rules.fallback_to_native: Plan the integration or work from exported data.

rules.why_this_plugin: Codex native ability is sufficient and extra tooling would add complexity without improving the immediate result.
rules.when_to_skip: A real file, repository, design source, account, or current information becomes necessary.
rules.fallback_to_native: Start the work immediately with Codex native ability.
